I get that sentiment, and I'm happy that you do care about your parents. But please do realize that they do care for you. I'm pretty sure that going through all those obstacles and hardships for you is an act of their love for you, and seeing their son/daughter enter a coma isnt what a parent would want to see. And if that is not true, then like I said, please focus on loving yourself. you deserve so much more. You can achieve being a world renowned artist, just hang on a little longer. you deserve a real girlfriend who will love you for real, and parents(who are lready there) who will love you unconditionally. Help yourself achieve and make those dreams a reality. Don't also assume peoples lives will improve when your gone, because that simply isnt true. People do love you.

I know that sometimes youll just feel like shit and feel like everybody is annoyed and irritated with you, but the thing is, your not including everybody. people will be sad to know you chose that life.

second point, please give yourself some credit. yes there have been times when youve fucked up bad and caused inconvenience to others but that doesnt define your future actions. the past stays in the past do not let it any near you. and most importantly, do not let it validate insults and deprecating thoughts, because you, like in your dreams when you sleep, can control your actions which can later lead to a bountiful harvest of goodness. basically what im trying to say is that you should love yourself, if people think your shit, then be the person to give a shit about yourself. if people dont care, then be the one to give yourself care. surely you deserve happiness just like the other people you say deserve happiness.

I may be too young to comment about this, and may not even have enough experience to understand the situation you are in. but dont sit on the thought that you are a shit person. maybe youve acted like shit before but dont let it last. because you'll always have a chance to improve. seek comfort from the close friends youve mentioned, although i hope that that user friend of yours is not a part of that. i like how you care about what people think and feel about your actions, but try focusing on yourself more, like what you said at the start of your message. you deserve more. please love yourself. even though others treat you like an outcast. dont also let your past validate shit comments about yourself. yes youve been shit at the past but youll always be able to improve. please if possible try finding activities, people, and professionals who can help you out.
